title: mcring AskRequest (multipart form fields)
description: POST /v1/ask is multipart/form-data — one voice turn. File parts (both optional): `audio` = the spoken question (WAV, m4a/mp4 phone recording, mp3/ogg/flac/webm, or a raw mcring-ADPCM ring clip as `.adpcm` / `audio/x-mcring-adpcm`) and `image` = a JPEG/PNG/WebP photo from the ring (omit for a pure voice turn; a photo already in the session stays referenced). A turn needs a question (text or audio) or a photo, otherwise 400; a recording that transcribes to nothing gives 422. The text fields are listed here; they mirror the Form(...) parameters of `ask()` in backend/app/main.py (python/mcring_core/tests/test_schemas.py keeps them in step).

question.description: Typed question. Combined with the transcript when `audio` is also sent; empty = the mode's default question.

mode.description: Without any photo every mode behaves as `chat` (question used verbatim); the response reports the effective mode.

session_id.description: Opaque id from a previous response; lets follow-up questions refer to the previous turns and photo. Empty = start a new session.

want_speech.description: Omitted/null = server default (true when a TTS provider is configured). true = synthesize `speech_text` server-side; false = the phone speaks `speech_text` itself.

speech_format.description: mp3 → `speech` (phone / headphones); adpcm16k → `speech_adpcm` (16 kHz mcring-ADPCM for the ring speaker); both → both.

voice.description: TTS voice; empty = the server's default voice.

want_morse.description: Optional silent-pattern output (`short` + `morse` in the response). Off by default.

morse_overall_wpm.description: Only with want_morse; Farnsworth overall speed (clamped to <= morse_char_wpm).

morse_channels.description: Only with want_morse: Feedback channel bits baked into morse.ring_packet_b64 (bit0 LED, bit1 haptic, bit2 buzzer, bit3 aux).

max_short_chars.description: Only with want_morse: length cap for `short`.
